checkRuns.command:
python3 - <<'EOF'
p='src/routes/contact.kay'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("t.Object({ name: t.String(), email: t.String(), message: t.String() })","t.Object({ name: t.String({ maxLength: 200 }), email: t.String({ maxLength: 320 }), message: t.String({ maxLength: 10000 }) })")
s=s.replace("failed?.data.errors ?? {}","failed?.data?.errors ?? {}")
s=s.replace("sentName?: string","")
s=s.replace("const sentName = succeeded?.data.name","const sentName = succeeded?.data?.name ?? ''").replace("sentName={sentName}","sentName={sentName}")
open(p,'w').write(s)
p='src/components/contact-form.kay'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("sentName?: string }","sentName: string }").replace("signal<string | undefined>(sentName)","signal<string>(sentName)").replace("sent.set(undefined)","sent.set('')")
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
bun run check 2>&1 | tail -40

pkill -f "src/server.ts"; bun run build 2>&1 | tail -2; (PORT=4567 bun run start > /tmp/s.log 2>&1 &); sleep 3
curl -s localhost:4567/books/dracula | tr '\n' ' ' | grep -o "<header.*</footer>" | sed 's/data-props="[^"]*"/data-props=…/'
echo; curl -s localhost:4567/books/nope | grep -o "<header.*</footer>"
echo ---POST; curl -s -i -X POST localhost:4567/_kay/action/contact/send -H 'Origin: http://localhost:4567' -H 'Referer: http://localhost:4567/contact' -d 'name=+&email=bad&message=short' | tr '\n' ' ' | sed 's/data-props="[^"]*"/data-props=…/' | cut -c1-2500
bun run build 2>&1 | tail -2; (PORT=4567 setsid bun run start > /tmp/s.log 2>&1 &); sleep 3; curl -s localhost:4567/about | head -c 100

pkill -f "bun src/server" ; sleep 1; bun run check 2>&1 | tail -3; bun run build 2>&1 | tail -2; (PORT=4568 setsid bun run start >/tmp/s2.log 2>&1 &); sleep 3; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" localhost:4568/books; pkill -f "bun src/server"; sleep 1; pgrep -fa "src/server" ; git status --short | head -20
pgrep -fa "[s]rc/server" ; pkill -f "[b]un src/server"; sleep 1; bun run check 2>&1 | tail -3; bun run build 2>&1 | tail -2
